commands.review_summary:
This PR trims Kimi K2 API keys before Authorization, adds an invalid-credentials error for 401/403 responses, covers the fetcher with injected-transport tests, and updates the changelog.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: current main sends the untrimmed API key and preserves non-200 response bodies, while the PR maps all 403 responses to invalid credentials. Kimrel's docs describe 403 as insufficient credits or permissions, which makes the PR bug reproducible by source inspection.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] A narrow automated repair can keep the useful token trim and 401 mapping while restoring actionable 403 handling.

target.title: Improve Kimi K2 credential errors
target.body:
## Summary

- trim Kimi K2 API keys before constructing the Authorization header
- classify HTTP 401 and 403 as invalid credentials instead of generic API failures
- add an actionable invalid-or-expired credential message
- add deterministic request and status mapping coverage through an injected transport
- add changelog credit for @joeVenner

## Production-path proof

A source-blind executable linked against `CodexBarCore` exercised the public fetcher through an isolated HTTP transport:

```text
PASS success-and-trim
PASS rejected-401
PASS rejected-403
PASS server-error
RESULT PASS 4/4
```

The freshly packaged `CodexBarCLI` also called the real legacy endpoint with a synthetic invalid key. Both output formats returned exit 1 with the exact actionable message:

```text
Error: Kimi K2 API key is invalid or expired.
```

The JSON path returned the same message as a provider error. No real secret was used for the rejection proof.

Authenticated success proof remains blocked: the existing Chrome-profile connection is unavailable, and opening a fresh Chrome window requires user confirmation. The separately verified Kimi Code credential targets a different service.

## Testing

- `swift test --disable-sandbox --filter KimiK2UsageFetcherTests` (12 passed)
- `make check` (SwiftFormat clean; SwiftLint 0 violations)
- `make test` (49/49 groups passed)
- packaged app signature verification passed; packaged CLI reports `CodexBar 0.41.0`
- autoreview clean (0.96 confidence)
- `git diff --check`
